topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I never thought the day would come when I'd have to mull over something as simple as sharing a corner of the yard. But here I am, pacing the length of my kitchen, the request hanging heavy in the air like an uninvited guest. I can feel the weight of it, pressing down, making the space smaller, the walls closer. It's not just a patch of grass and dirt; it's a piece of my world, my sanctuary. Can I truly part with it, even if just a fraction? The thought swirls, growing larger, more fearsome in the silence. What if this changes everything, ripples out into something I can't control? I need to think, to breathe, to find a way through this maze of uncertainty.
